points.title: 早年艺术启蒙
points.description: 埃德加·德加出生于巴黎一个富裕的银行家家庭，从小接受良好的教育。1845年进入路易大帝中学(Lycée Louis-le-Grand)，1853年获得学士学位。这一时期，德加受到古典艺术和文学的影响，尤其对古希腊罗马艺术产生浓厚兴趣。他的父亲希望他成为律师，但德加对艺术的热情最终促使他违背父亲的意愿，转向艺术创作。这一阶段奠定了他深厚的艺术素养和对古典艺术的鉴赏能力。
points.descriptionEn: Born in Paris to a wealthy banking family, Edgar Degas received an excellent education. He entered Lycée Louis-le-Grand in 1845 and graduated with a bachelor's degree in 1853. During this period, Degas was influenced by classical art and literature, developing a strong interest in ancient Greek and Roman art. His father hoped he would become a lawyer, but Degas's passion for art eventually led him to defy his father's wishes and pursue a career in art. This phase laid the foundation for his profound artistic literacy and appreciation for classical art.

points.title: 古典艺术研究
points.description: 1854年，德加前往意大利罗马，在那里度过了五年时间。他深入研究文艺复兴大师的作品，特别是拉斐尔、米开朗基罗和提香的作品。这一时期，德加创作了大量素描和油画，包括《贝尔维德尔的风景》等作品。他还多次前往那不勒斯和佛罗伦萨，深入考察意大利艺术传统。这段经历极大地丰富了德加的艺术视野，使他掌握了古典绘画技巧，同时也开始形成自己独特的艺术风格，为他后来的印象派创作奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 1854, Degas traveled to Rome, where he spent five years. He studied the works of Renaissance masters, particularly Raphael, Michelangelo, and Titian. During this period, Degas created numerous sketches and paintings, including works like 'View of the Belvedere.' He also made multiple trips to Naples and Florence to thoroughly study Italian artistic traditions. This experience greatly broadened Degas's artistic perspective, enabling him to master classical painting techniques while beginning to develop his unique artistic style, laying the foundation for his later Impressionist works.

points.title: 印象派探索期
points.description: 返回巴黎后，德加开始接触印象派画家，并与马奈、莫奈、雷诺阿等艺术家建立联系。1862年，他放弃了古典绘画风格，转向现代题材创作。这一时期，德加创作了《室内场景》、《芭蕾舞女》等标志性作品，开始关注现代都市生活和女性形象。1863年，他参加了拒绝派画展(Salon des Refusés)，1867年举办了首次个人画展。德加在这一阶段逐渐形成了自己独特的艺术语言，注重构图和线条的表现力，同时开始探索光影效果，为印象派运动做出了重要贡献。
points.descriptionEn: After returning to Paris, Degas began to associate with Impressionist painters and established connections with artists such as Manet, Monet, and Renoir. In 1862, he abandoned classical painting styles and turned to modern subject matter. During this period, Degas created iconic works like 'Interior Scenes' and 'Dancer,' beginning to focus on modern urban life and female imagery. In 1863, he participated in the Salon des Refusés, and in 1867 held his first solo exhibition. During this phase, Degas gradually developed his unique artistic language, emphasizing composition and linear expression while exploring light and shadow effects, making significant contributions to the Impressionist movement.

points.title: 美国之旅
points.description: 1870年普法战争爆发后，德加因视力问题无法参军，前往美国新奥尔良探望舅舅。在美国期间，德加创作了《棉花交易所》等重要作品，这是他唯一一幅在美国创作的杰作。这幅作品展现了美国南方的商业生活，体现了德加对现代都市生活的关注。美国之行对德加的艺术产生了深远影响，他开始更加关注日常生活场景，并尝试新的构图方式。1872年返回巴黎后，德加的艺术风格更加成熟，作品中的现代感和生活气息更加浓厚。
points.descriptionEn: With the outbreak of the Franco-Prussian War in 1870, Degas was unable to serve due to vision problems and traveled to New Orleans, USA, to visit his uncle. During his time in America, Degas created important works including 'The Cotton Exchange,' the only masterpiece he painted in the United States. This painting depicted the commercial life of the American South, reflecting Degas's focus on modern urban life. His American journey had a profound impact on his art, leading him to pay greater attention to everyday scenes and experiment with new compositional approaches. After returning to Paris in 1872, Degas's artistic style became more mature, with his works showing enhanced modernity and vitality of daily life.

points.title: 印象派鼎盛时期
points.description: 这一时期是德加艺术创作的黄金时期。他积极参与印象派展览，共参加了八次印象派画展(1874, 1876, 1877, 1879, 1880, 1881, 1882, 1886)。德加创作了大量以芭蕾舞女、洗衣妇、赛马等为主题的作品，如《舞蹈课》、《芭蕾舞女》系列、《洗衣妇》等。他发展出独特的构图技巧，常采用俯视角度和裁剪式构图，使画面更具现代感。德加还开始尝试雕塑创作，创作了著名的《十四岁的舞者》等雕塑作品。这一时期，德加的艺术风格完全成熟，成为印象派运动中独具特色的重要代表人物。
points.descriptionEn: This period marked the golden age of Degas's artistic creation. He actively participated in Impressionist exhibitions, taking part in eight Impressionist exhibitions (1874, 1876, 1877, 1879, 1880, 1881, 1882, 1886). Degas created numerous works featuring ballerinas, laundresses, horse racing, and other subjects, such as 'The Dance Class,' the 'Dancer' series, and 'Laundresses.' He developed unique compositional techniques, often using bird's-eye views and cropped compositions to create a more modern feel in his paintings. Degas also began experimenting with sculpture, creating famous works like 'The Little Fourteen-Year-Old Dancer.' During this period, Degas's artistic style reached full maturity, establishing him as a distinctive and important figure in the Impressionist movement.

points.title: 晚年艺术探索
points.description: 晚年时期，德加的视力逐渐恶化，这迫使他转向雕塑和版画创作。他继续创作芭蕾舞女主题的作品，但风格变得更加抽象和表现性。德加对新兴艺术形式如摄影表现出浓厚兴趣，并尝试将摄影元素融入自己的作品中。1900年后，德加逐渐减少参展，但创作热情不减。他晚年作品中的孤独感和对生命流逝的思考更加明显。1917年，德加在巴黎逝世，享年83岁。他一生创作了超过2000幅画作、150多尊雕塑和大量版画作品，对后世艺术产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: In his later years, Degas's gradually deteriorating vision forced him to turn to sculpture and printmaking. He continued creating works featuring ballerinas, but his style became more abstract and expressive. Degas developed a keen interest in emerging art forms like photography and attempted to incorporate photographic elements into his works. After 1900, Degas gradually reduced his exhibition participation but maintained his creative enthusiasm. The sense of loneliness and reflection on the passage of time became more evident in his late works. Degas died in Paris in 1917 at the age of 83. Throughout his life, he created over 2,000 paintings, more than 150 sculptures, and numerous prints, leaving a profound impact on future generations of artists.

supporter.zh: 德加被艺术史学家誉为现代艺术的先驱之一，他的创新构图和独特视角彻底改变了传统绘画的表现方式。他捕捉现代都市生活的敏锐眼光和对女性形象的诗意表达，为后世艺术家开辟了新的创作道路。德加对芭蕾舞女主题的深入探索，不仅展现了他对人体动态的精湛把握，更揭示了艺术背后的社会观察。他的作品超越了简单的印象派风格，融合了古典技法和现代意识，形成了独特的艺术语言。
supporter.en: Degas is hailed by art historians as one of the pioneers of modern art, whose innovative compositions and unique perspectives revolutionized traditional painting methods. His keen eye for capturing modern urban life and poetic expression of female imagery opened new creative paths for future artists. Degas's profound exploration of the ballerina theme not only demonstrates his masterful grasp of human dynamics but also reveals the social observation behind his art. His works transcended simple Impressionist styles, blending classical techniques with modern consciousness to form a distinctive artistic language.

critic.zh: 批评者指出德加的作品存在明显的阶级局限性，他主要描绘上流社会和娱乐场所，很少关注社会底层和贫困问题。德加对女性形象的描绘也受到争议，有批评认为他强化了女性作为'被观看对象'的客体地位，而非展现女性的主体性。此外，德加性格孤僻，与印象派其他成员关系疏远，缺乏社会参与意识，这与同时代更具社会责任感的艺术家形成鲜明对比。他的艺术创新虽然形式上突破传统，但在内容上仍局限于个人兴趣和审美偏好。
critic.en: Critics point out that Degas's work exhibits clear class limitations, primarily depicting upper-class society and entertainment venues while rarely focusing on the lower classes and poverty issues. His portrayal of female figures has also been controversial, with some arguing that he reinforced women's status as objects of the gaze rather than showcasing their subjectivity. Furthermore, Degas's reclusive personality and distant relationships with other Impressionists, along with his lack of social consciousness, contrast sharply with more socially engaged artists of his time. While his artistic innovations broke new ground formally, they remained confined to personal interests and aesthetic preferences in content.

objective.zh: 在艺术史和流行文化中，德加被定义为印象派运动中独具特色的关键人物，他既不完全属于传统印象派，又超越了其界限。他的作品以其独特的构图视角和对现代生活的敏锐捕捉而闻名，特别是芭蕾舞女系列已成为艺术史上的经典符号。德加的艺术遗产体现在他对现代艺术形式的探索和对传统技法的创新融合上。在当代流行文化中，德加的作品经常被引用和重新诠释，成为时尚、舞蹈和现代视觉艺术的重要灵感来源。他的艺术成就不仅在于形式创新，更在于他如何通过艺术捕捉现代性体验的本质。
objective.en: In art history and popular culture, Degas is defined as a distinctive key figure in the Impressionist movement who neither completely belonged to traditional Impressionism nor transcended its boundaries. His works are renowned for their unique compositional perspectives and keen capture of modern life, particularly his ballerina series which has become iconic in art history. Degas's artistic legacy lies in his exploration of modern art forms and innovative fusion of traditional techniques. In contemporary popular culture, Degas's works are frequently referenced and reinterpreted, serving as important sources of inspiration for fashion, dance, and modern visual arts. His artistic achievements extend beyond formal innovations to how he captured the essence of modern experience through art.

self.zh: 艺术不是你所看到的，而是你让别人看到的。
self.en: Art is not what you see, but what you make others see.

others.zh: 德加是唯一一位真正理解美的画家，他能够从最平凡的事物中发现诗意。
others.en: Degas was the only painter who truly understood beauty; he could find poetry in the most ordinary things.
